caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure with pale skin and black hair parted in the middle and styled close to the head. She is wearing a long, full-skirted, white dress adorned with a pattern of small purple flowers and green leaves. The dress has wide, ruffled sleeves and several layers of fabric forming the skirt, giving it a voluminous appearance. The dress also features a fitted bodice and a high waistline. The underskirt is visible at the hem and is decorated with white lace trim. She has on white stockings with a floral pattern and black shoes with bows. Around her neck, there is a green bead necklace. Her cheeks are rosy, lips are red, and her hands placed at her sides, with one slightly bent at the elbow. The background is plain and uncolored, and the name "Anne Colman" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll
